title: Don't Mess with This Guy's Wife
description:
A Texas man found himself in cuffs after an explosive reaction to a speeding ticket. Police took Trenton Futrell into custody after the man allegedly berated police who were attempting to give him a simple ticket for speeding 10mph over the speed limit. Officers let the behavior slide until they discovered the man had a traffic warrant. Then, when officers went to arrest the man, a chaotic scene unfolded. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
